calculations.label: Instructional staff with faculty status, full-time plus part-time
calculations.interpretation: Per release year (Fall 2015-2024), for Yale University, sum EAPFT and EAPPT on the EAPCAT=21010 row (Instructional staff, With faculty status). Full-time and part-time are disjoint headcounts on the same row. Annual EAPCAT 21010 IDs: 2015=11912, 2016=29281, 2017=41429, 2018=56517, 2019=74309, 2020=88757, 2021=103524, 2022=119137, 2023=135288, 2024=149033. Annual EAPFT IDs: 14389, 16823, 32394, 47228, 62312, 77362, 92180, 106395, 122383, 137678. Annual EAPPT IDs: 14392, 16826, 32397, 47231, 62315, 77365, 92183, 106398, 122386, 137681 (in year order 2015-2024). Reported per year, not aggregated across years.

assumptions: EAP rows are selected with EAPCAT=21010 (Instructional staff, With faculty status), which is the same code label in all ten annual releases.
The measure is a headcount from EAPFT plus EAPPT; medical-school-specific columns are not separately selected, so these totals follow the source EAPFT/EAPPT definitions.
Release labels 2015-2024 are treated as the Fall 2015-2024 collections; the EAP2019 table title text says Fall 2017 but its file title says Fall 2019, and this is kept visible, not harmonized.
Yale University is resolved by name to its UNITID at execution.
